title: Claims Commercial - Baseline - Date attribute (Date of Loss, Date of Notification)

Not from BMPCC-219: the CWB location lookup below has no Jira source and is kept here because it was built on this screen (CWB-01 to CWB-05).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Dates captured on Loss Information propagate to Entities & Damages
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira AC1: *Given* dates are captured on the Loss Event page, *when* navigating to the E&D page, *then* Date of Loss and Date of Notification propagate automatically.

**What the screen does:** Date of occurrence and Date of notification are captured on `/fnol/loss-information`. The Entities & Damages step shows no dates at all, so nothing visible propagates there. Each section later follows the claim date of loss unless changed (see BMPCC-22328 AC-03). Marked `partial`.

setup.description: Seed FNOL policy so the user lands directly on Loss Information

preconditions.text: FNOL is past search: selected policy POL-2024-001
Loss Information shows Date of occurrence and Date of notification
Entities & Damages step shows no date fields

expectedUI.description: Dates captured on Loss Information; E&D has no date display
visualCues: Date of occurrence and Date of notification fields on Loss Information
No date shown on Entities & Damages

howToTest.trigger: Fill both dates, then go Next to Entities & Damages
howToTest.expectedResult: Dates are kept in the claim, but E&D shows no date fields

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Jira AC2 to AC5 (damage-level date toggle, override, Kafka override) are struck through in Jira
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira AC2, AC3, AC4 and AC5 are struck through (on hold): the "Different date than event date" toggle on the damage screen, date fields shown when no event date exists, and damage-level overrides in the Kafka event.

**What the screen does:** no damage-level date toggle is built in FNOL. The nearest built thing is the per-section date of loss on the Sections page (BMPCC-22328 AC-03). Marked `todo` because Jira has these on hold.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Event-level dates are the default for damage-level dates in the Kafka event
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira AC6: *Given* event-level dates exist, *when* publishing the Kafka event, *then* damage-level dates default to event-level values.

**What the screen does:** this is a backend event. The prototype has no Kafka or MongoDB, so there is nothing to show. Marked `todo`.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Date of Loss cannot be later than Date of Notification
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
Jira AC7: *Given* Date of Loss and Date of Notification are entered, *when* validation runs, *then* Date of Loss cannot be greater than Date of Notification.

**What the screen does:** on `/fnol/loss-information`, the Date of notification hint reads *must be on or after date of occurrence*. If the notification date is earlier, the group error *Notification date must be on or after occurrence date* shows and Next is blocked.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Not from BMPCC-219: built for CWB loss location lookup, no Jira source. Modal exposes the required search params per spec
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: **Not from BMPCC-219: built for CWB loss location lookup, no Jira source.** The CWB modal exposes **7 search params**: *Policy number* (read-only), *Location rule number* (read-only), `Country`, `City`, `ZIP / postal code`, `Street and number`, `Geo-coordinates`. Read-only fields are pre-filled from the policy mapping.

setup.description: Same setup as AC-01: opens modal with pre-filled values

preconditions.text: Policy number = POL-2024-001 (read-only)
Location rule number = LRN-2024-PROP-001 (read-only, derived)
Country / City / ZIP / Street / Geo-coordinates are editable

expectedUI.description: Form layout: 3-column grid with read-only and editable fields
visualCues: Policy number input is disabled with hint 'Pre-filled from selected policy (read-only)'
Location rule number input is disabled with hint 'Derived from policy mapping (read-only)'
Country dropdown is required (asterisk in label)
City / ZIP / Street and number / Geo-coordinates inputs editable

howToTest.expectedResult: All 7 fields visible with correct edit-state

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Not from BMPCC-219: built for CWB loss location lookup, no Jira source. Mandatory-field validation on Policy / Rule / Country
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: **Not from BMPCC-219: built for CWB loss location lookup, no Jira source.** **Search** is `disabled` until *Policy*, *Rule*, and *Country* are populated. With Policy and Rule pre-filled, the user must select a Country before search becomes enabled. Field error appears on Country if user submits while empty.

setup.description: Open modal: Country is the only blank required field

preconditions.text: On modal open, Search button is disabled (Country empty)
After picking any Country, Search becomes enabled
Clicking Search with Country empty surfaces the error 'Country is required.'

visualCues: Search button disabled when Country empty
Validation hint appears when user attempts search with Country empty
Optional fields (City, ZIP, Street, Geo-coords) never block search

howToTest.trigger: Open CWB modal, leave Country empty → attempt search
howToTest.expectedResult: Search remains disabled; error appears under Country if forced
